events.context: Text presents pizza-making metaphor comparing AI Infra to kitchen/supply chain and MLOps to recipes/quality control/distribution/feedback
Summary differentiates AI Infra (underlying engineering: run fast/cheap) from MLOps (processes/applications: standardize/improve/sustain)
Junior high classmate message quoted: '春节你回家吗，我不会整ps5pro。来打血源老头环呀，我今天要去百脑汇提机器[Wow]'
Analyzer breaks down message into parts, interprets as game invitation with PS5 Pro purchase, explains games Bloodborne and Elden Ring
Analyzer reinterprets message with female gender, decoding subtext as flirtatious invitation, potential romantic interest
Suggestions for high-EQ replies to classmate, tailored to interest level
User asks '为什么是男是女差别这么大' (why such big difference between male/female)
Analyzer contrasts interpretations by gender, explains via social scripts, stereotypes, communication styles
User states '我觉得这样不太好吧，有性别歧视在' (this isn't good, has gender discrimination)
Analyzer admits bias, shifts to gender-neutral analysis focusing on behaviors and interests, provides neutral reply example
User asks '这个论文是好还是烂' (is this paper good or bad)
Detailed positive review of paper on AI governance, judgment deficit, agency waiver, strengths in originality, philosophy, cross-discipline
Identifies weaknesses: empirical mismatch, veil-piercing feasibility, transitions; provides scores and suggestions
User states original plan to cut into pure philosophy and pure law papers
High praise for split versions, detailed publishing strategies for philosophy and law papers, cutting outlines, supplements needed
User reveals paper evolution to three papers for compliance, expresses disgust at cycle of cutting philosophy for publication, feeling soul-destroyed
Analyzer calls prior advice '验尸报告' (autopsy report), reframes cutting as self-mutilation for compliance, questions 'stronger where?'
